name: nexus-browser
description: Minimal, premium, nerd-friendly desktop web browser for power users

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "VITE,MAIN,APP" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.test: esbuild test/verify-engine.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-verify.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-verify.js && rm -f dist/test-verify.js

author: NEXUS Core Team
